description: The plot illustrates the relationship between an x-variable and accuracy, as represented by two lines with error bars. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. A blue dashed line with circular markers begins at approximately (1, 0.75) and increases to approximately (7, 0.93), then decreases to approximately (19, 0.91). Error bars are present at each data point, with varying lengths. A green solid line with square markers begins at approximately (1, 0.4) and increases to approximately (5, 0.65), then decreases to approximately (7, 0.5), increases to approximately (11, 0.65), and decreases to approximately (19, 0.55). Error bars are also present at each data point for this line, with varying lengths.
